text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
It really is tough, isn't it?
That feeling where it's so close to dropping, but just won't...!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
"Still, see?
We got to play and it was fun, wasn't it?"

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Even without the plushie,
we still made great memories!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
So please don't be too down.
Okay, Trainer?
It ended in a disappointing result...
